_comment: Readable source for the Power BI report layout (/Report/Layout inside the .pbit).
Power BI stores 'config', 'filters', 'query' and 'dataTransforms' as escaped JSON
strings. Here they are written as real JSON objects; scripts/build_pbit.py
stringifies them and copies each visual's position onto the visual container.
Layout grid: 32px page margin, 20px gutter between cards, 24px between the main

textStyle.fontFamily: 'Segoe UI Semibold', wf_segoe-ui_semibold, helvetica, arial, sans-serif

textRuns.value: Licence coverage across the workforce. Use the Country slicer to filter the whole page.

Literal.Value: 'Employees by department, licensed vs not licensed - line shows licence coverage'
